v4PoolManager.note: Contract name PoolManager; deployed via the deterministic CREATE2 deployer 0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C. ~$29M TVL, 28.8k txns, ~48 Initialize events per 2000 blocks (2026-09-04). This is the primary launch venue on 4663.

v3Factory.note: Blockscout metadata_tag UniswapV3Factory; same deployer (0x9701fb0aDe1E269c8f64Ec0C7b3cfADB31A13A52) as the v2 factory tag. Alternate is the cross-chain canonical address, also tagged. No PoolCreated seen in a small live window — confirm range/address from a real v3 launch before trusting.

v2Factory.note: Blockscout metadata_tag UniswapV2Factory; emits PairCreated live (~2 per 2000 blocks, 2026-09-04). LONG's stock-paired pools may land here.

quoteAssets.note: Quote/base assets. Used to tell the new token from the paired asset in a fresh pool, and (later) for liquidity_usd_10m + sell_impact_bps (spec §3.3.7). USDG confirmed from a real v4 Initialize + Blockscout token page (verified). WETH has several deployments on 4663; both verified candidates included.

launchpads.label: Pons
launchpads.note: Dominant pad (~64% of tracked launchpad fees). 4 verified 'PonsFactory' contracts on-chain, none with logs in a small window — pick the high-volume one from a recent ponslaunchpad.com launch tx (167k+ tokens => very high tx count).

launchpads.label: LONG
launchpads.note: Pairs new tokens against Robinhood tokenized stocks (NVDA, HIMS, ...). Non-launchpad LP shape => LIQ_IMPAIRED / SELL_IMPAIRED may apply. Find factory from a long.xyz launch tx.

launchpads.label: Hookr.fun
launchpads.note: Uniswap v4 hook launchpad, pool-first. Its pools appear in v4 Initialize with a non-zero hooks address — group by hooks contract once identified. HOOKR token 0x18E674231A58c239Dc7DaeDcffE15Ec3A24cff5c.

launchpads.label: v4.fun (Canopy)
launchpads.note: Canopy / $CNPY (0x701257ee548006e7b60f3abd4bd9b74c65f2d87a). Find factory from a v4.fun token 'created' tx.

launchpads.label: Noxa
launchpads.note: Largely deprecated; kept for backfill coverage (spec §7). $NOXA 0xeC111891ba1DaCD3DdCE6bACd4b53312BcAF72af. Noxa restricts launch-block buys to the creator (spec §3.2).

launchpads.label: Sentry
launchpads.note: Small (~$180k TVL per DeFiLlama). Inspect the deployer of 'sentrylauncher' token 0x432e63E00DBC8EFd1109C263dBedCb793609F7Af.

launchpads.label: Virtuals Protocol
launchpads.note: AI-agent tokens; 5,600+ agents on 4663 in the first month. VIRTUAL 0xc6911796042b15d7Fa4F6CDe69e245DdCd3d9c31. Virtuals uses a bonding-curve genesis/factory contract — find the 4663 deployment; tokens graduate to v4.

launchpads.label: pools.trade
launchpads.note: Uniswap Labs pool-first launch. Likely emits only v4 Initialize with a known periphery router as tx.to and no separate factory event — attribute by the router address in the launch tx.
